purpose: Menu and HUD visual alternatives requested before choosing an implementation direction

prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a beautiful high-fidelity visual proposal for DRONE LIFTOFF, a desktop FPV drone simulator. This is variation 01 'SOFT GRAPHITE'. ONE concept board with TWO full-width equally sized 16:9 screenshots vertically stacked, upper main menu, lower in-flight HUD. Overall portrait board, both screens large and readable. Small understated caption above upper screen '01 — SOFT GRAPHITE'. User wants MUCH softer, more rounded, more minimal and less busy than typical racing game interfaces. Art direction: elegant calm charcoal #191b22, soft off-white #f4f2f9, subtle lavender #bdb5f5 accents. Generous 24-32px rounded corners, soft depth, no hard borders, no uppercase condensed racing type, clean contemporary sans-serif, very few labels. Upper screen: restrained DRONE LIFTOFF wordmark top left, only 'Fly', 'Hangar', 'Settings' small navigation, tiny pilot avatar right. Large friendly heading 'A little more sky.' on left, one short subtitle 'Pick a place. Find your flow.' Three roomy rounded mode tiles 'Free flight', 'Race', 'Learn' with simple quiet line icons, first selected lavender. A single lavender pill 'Choose location →' below. Right 60 percent shows large beautifully lit realistic carbon FPV quadcopter with subdued lavender propeller tips floating above a dark softly lit studio floor, large negative space, no surrounding statistics. Tiny unobtrusive footer 'Keyboard or radio controller'. Lower screen: lovely actual FPV daytime green valley view with a racing gate ahead, the same soft visual system. HUD only a small rounded translucent pill top left 'Free flight · Valley', top right tiny 'Acro · FPV', bottom left quiet pill '64 km/h   12 m', bottom right tiny battery icon and '82%', faint center dot, tiny 'Esc Pause' bottom center. More than 90 percent of landscape unobstructed. No charts, no grids, no status tables, no decorative stripes, no dozens of tiny metrics, no neon glow, no sharp corners. Strong realistic professional finished game UI, harmonious relaxed proportions, no watermark.

Use case ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity visual proposal for DRONE LIFTOFF desktop FPV simulator, variation 02 'AIR / PEARL'. ONE concept board, TWO equally sized full-width 16:9 screenshots stacked vertically; upper main menu lower actual in-flight HUD, portrait board. Small understated heading '02 — AIR / PEARL'. Make this a clearly different structural and aesthetic option from a dark gaming console menu: warm bright pearl #f3f1eb background, charcoal text #282d2a, natural muted sage #aac7ad, extremely soft 28px roundness, tactile subtle shadows, clean humanist sans serif, airy editorial composition. Upper screen: small DRONE LIFTOFF brand top left, 'Fly   Aircraft   Settings' quiet text nav upper right, simple avatar. Big heading 'Room to fly.' with short subtitle 'Your next flight starts here.' in a spacious left column, then a minimal vertical list of three activity choices separated only by space: '01  Free flight', '02  Race', '03  Flight school', first in a pale sage softly rounded selected pill. No tile grid. Primary dark charcoal rounded pill 'Explore locations ↗' lower left. Right big gorgeous realistic black and silver racing quadcopter hovering above a clean pale sand-colored surface in diffused daylight, soft sage propeller tips, no visible laboratory or shop clutter. One tiny badge 'Kestrel 5' under aircraft. Lots of unoccupied space. Lower screen: beautiful sunny pale limestone coast and calm sea with FPV race gate ahead. Minimal HUD same friendly rounded design: small frosted ivory pill top left 'Coast · Race', tiny top center '00:28.4' with small '1 / 3 laps', top right little 'Acro'. Bottom left ivory translucent pill '72 km/h', bottom right small dark battery outline '86%', center almost invisible tiny dot, bottom center 'Esc Pause'. Over 90% unobstructed view. Minimal calm softness, no hard outlines, no dashboard full of statistics, no condensed aggressive typography, no neon, no sharp-edged cards. Realistic implementable finished game interface, no device frames no watermark.

Use case ui-mockup. High fidelity UI concept proposal for DRONE LIFTOFF FPV game, option 03 'CINEMATIC / SUNSET'. One portrait concept board with TWO large wide 16:9 game screenshots vertically stacked; upper MAIN MENU lower IN-FLIGHT HUD. Small tasteful caption '03 — CINEMATIC / SUNSET'. This option should look completely different from a studio drone on one side and menu tiles on the other: immersive full-bleed scenic background, very little interface, calm elegant rounded controls. Upper main menu fills the whole screen with a photoreal cinematic FPV flying location at sunset: a winding red-rock canyon and beautiful warm sunlight haze, small racing quadcopter in the mid-distance on right, atmospheric clouds, room to breathe. Small white DRONE LIFTOFF branding top left, tiny avatar top right. Lower left simple large soft sans-serif heading 'Go where it takes you.' and one short line 'Canyon Ridge · Golden hour'. Under it a single frosted warm gray rounded capsule segmented control 'Free flight / Race / Learn', active item pale peach #f2b99d. One generous pill primary 'Fly here →' and a quiet 'Change location' text button. Upper center only two quiet links 'Hangar' and 'Settings'. NO panels, no big tile grid, no technical tables, no info footer. Color: warm natural sunset scenery, cream type, matte peach accent, rounded 24px and pill forms, very light subtle glass that stays readable. Lower HUD: actual first-person flight approaching a simple gate in same canyon at golden hour. Top left small rounded translucent dark pill 'Canyon Ridge · Race'; top right quiet 'Acro'. Bottom center ONE small rounded translucent instrument pill combines '68 km/h' then separator then '00:18.6' then separator then a battery icon '84%'. Tiny lap label immediately above pill 'Lap 1 / 3'. Tiny 'Esc Pause' lower right. Tiny center dot only. Center and sides of landscape completely open, HUD occupies under 8 percent of screen. Human-friendly nontechnical game menu, premium calm immersive art, no sharp-edged borders no neon no sci-fi decoration no hard condensed fonts no watermark.

Use case ui-mockup. Create a beautiful finished modern console game UI concept for DRONE LIFTOFF FPV drone simulator. Variation 04 'PLAY / MINT'. One concept board, TWO large equally sized wide 16:9 screenshots stacked vertically, upper MAIN MENU lower actual FLIGHT HUD, overall portrait board. Small caption '04 — PLAY / MINT'. Clearly distinct layout: main screen is LOCATION-FIRST with a horizontal photo carousel, not mode menu on left with a drone on right. Soft midnight-gray #20262a, off-white typography, gentle mint #a6e5cf accent, comfortable rounded shapes 26-32px radius, modern friendly medium-weight sans typography, soft shadows, generous whitespace, no thin technical border grid. Upper screen: compact DRONE LIFTOFF wordmark upper left, three-item centered rounded pill navigation 'Play / Garage / Settings', tiny avatar upper right. Heading 'Where next?' left near top and quiet mode selector pill 'Free flight v' on right. Center screen 3 wide rounded photographic LOCATION CARDS in horizontal carousel: selected center card 'Forest Run' showing a gorgeous green pine forest trail with physical racing gates, left smaller partial 'The Hangar' industrial photo, right smaller partial 'Canyon Ridge' red rocks photo. Strong image-first design, little text, selected card subtle mint edge and small 'Selected' pill. Lower center one mint rounded pill 'Start flying →', secondary quiet 'Fly with friends'. Tiny current aircraft chip 'Kestrel 5' bottom left. No giant dashboard, no stats rows, no dense icon grid. Lower screenshot same pine forest first-person flight with gate ahead. Minimal matching HUD: tiny rounded top left 'Forest Run' badge, top center small rounded timer '00:24.8' with 'Lap 1 / 3', top right 'Acro · FPV'. Bottom left medium airy white speed '56' and small 'km/h' with subtle tiny shadow, NO backing panel; bottom right small floating mint rounded battery pill '88%'; bottom center soft pill 'Esc  Pause'. Tiny mint dot in center. Over 90% open unobstructed landscape. Rounded game controls should feel cohesive, friendly and tangible. No sharp corners, no uppercase condensed typography, no neon, no fake minimaps, no dozens of tiny metrics, no sci-fi trim, no watermark or device frames.
